# Writer

Writer is a full-stack generative AI platform for enterprises, offering tools to build and deploy AI applications integrated with their suite of LLMs, graph-based RAG tools, and AI guardrails.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/writer/.

## Actions

- **Ask Question to Knowledge Graph** (read-only): Send a question to the knowledge graph and retrieve the answer.
- **Chat Completion** (read-only): Generate chat-based completions.
- **Create Knowledge Graph**: Create a new knowledge graph.
- **List Applications** (read-only): List all no-code agent applications.
- **List Files** (read-only): List all uploaded files.
- **List Knowledge Graphs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of knowledge graphs.
- **List Models** (read-only): List all available language models.
- **Retrieve Knowledge Graph** (read-only): Retrieve a knowledge graph by its id.
- **Text Generation** (read-only): Generate text based on a given prompt.
- **Update Knowledge Graph**: Update an existing knowledge graph.
- **Web Search** (read-only): Perform a web search.
- **Delete Graph**: Delete a knowledge graph by its id.
- **Medical Text Comprehension** (read-only): Extract medical entities and concepts from unstructured clinical text.
